phase_step: one full deterministic lexicographic strict coordinate sweep over {inactive,0,1,2,3,4} using the exact motif-factor objective at the current q
amplitude_step: exact exhaustive integer minimization over the active support's proven feasible interval
limits: at most 16 alternating rounds or 300 seconds, one process, no restart or seed
stopping_rule: stop after a complete phase sweep makes zero moves and exact amplitude minimization retains q
promotion: materialize only a strict exact-density improvement over phase-001; request the separate compressed typed-kernel recount rather than a generic direct recount
scope: one causal continuation of the immutable phase-001 assignment, not a kernel or seed sweep
